_note: Caption rewrites for the video, keyed by manifest shot id. Real button label first, plain meaning after. The manifest is not edited.
d025-safety-warning: A red warning appears before anything is sent. Call for help first, then tap Raise safety alert to warn everyone.
d029-safety-resolve: When the danger is over, a manager or the owner taps Resolve with sign-off. A false alarm gets Downgrade to false alarm instead.
d030-safety-second-alert: A gas smell turns out to be a false alarm. Downgrade to false alarm closes it, and the note stays in the log.
d032-detail-new: The details show what was asked, which team has it and a timer. Tap Relay to pass the request to that team.
d033-detail-sent: The team has it now. Tap On site when someone reaches the room.
d034-detail-on-site: Done closes the request. If the guest cannot be served yet, tap Hold… so it waits without counting as late.
d040-detail-tray-pickup: If the wrong team has the request, tap Transfer… and pick the department that should do it.
d043-detail-escalate: For a bigger repair, like an air conditioner that stays warm, tap Escalate to work order. It becomes a repair job.
d050-work-order-in-progress: While the work goes on, tap Put on hold if it has to wait, for example for a part.
d059-handover-return: Requests left by someone who went off shift go back to their team when you tap Return.
p10-phone-ticket-detail: Tap a request to see its steps. The big button does the next step, here Done.
d018-detail-finish-logging: Open the saved room, tap what the guest needs, then tap Add to ticket.
d069-sidebar-owner: The hotel owner sees all six tabs, including Insights and Settings.
d070-sidebar-manager: A manager also sees six tabs, and can change staff and lists, but not logins.
d071-settings-manager: In Settings, a manager finds Staff and Lists, but no Logins.
d072-sidebar-supervisor: A supervisor sees six tabs too, but in Settings only the display options.
d073-settings-supervisor: A supervisor has no Staff, Lists or Logins in Settings, only the display options.
